name: Supplying the Sepulcher
summary: At the Sepulcher, Deathguard Podrig seeks weapons for the hard-pressed garrison. He sends an order toward the Undercity as beasts, Scourge and other threats wear down its supplies.

sections.title: Arming the Front Line
sections.body: Deathguard Podrig says the Sepulcher is fairly well stocked, yet fighting in Silverpine Forest steadily drains its gear. Feral beasts, Scourge remnants and other local threats wear down weapons and armor or leave them behind after skirmishes. Acting under Executor Hadrec's orders, Podrig writes a requisition for Gordon Wendham, a weapon dealer in the Undercity. Replacement arms and armor help the Forsaken hold their fragile footholds beyond Tirisfal Glades.

sections.title: The Flight Network
sections.body: Silverpine's roads make a slow, dangerous route for vital messages and supplies. The Forsaken send them by trained vampire bats instead. Karos Razok handles the bats at the Sepulcher, linking its soldiers to the Undercity's aerial network and the routes connecting outlying garrisons to Sylvanas's capital.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Podrig's order?
faq.answer: Executor Hadrec ordered Deathguard Podrig to request weapons for the Sepulcher. Its general supplies were sufficient, but arms were needed to replace those broken or lost in fights with the Scourge and other forest threats.
Gordon Wendham is a weapon merchant in the Undercity. Podrig addresses the Sepulcher's request for new arms to him.
Karos Razok handles the bats at the Sepulcher. He oversees the dread bats that carry messengers, scouts and supplies across Lordaeron.

faq.q: Why use bats instead of road couriers?
faq.answer: The roads through Silverpine Forest are dangerous, with hostile beasts, Scourge and other factions threatening couriers. Bat routes offer a faster, safer connection to the Undercity.

faq.q: What threats does the Sepulcher face?
faq.answer: The Sepulcher faces lingering Scourge undead, worgen, wild beasts and regional human factions. The garrison needs steady replacements to remain ready for battle.

faq.q: Where does this task lead next?
faq.answer: Karos Razok can arrange flight transport to the Undercity, where the requisition is addressed to Gordon Wendham.

angles.text: As an Undead, you help maintain Forsaken outposts like the Sepulcher, extending their reach beyond Tirisfal Glades and securing the surrounding wilderness for the Dark Lady.
As a member of the Horde, you rely on flight routes between garrisons and capital cities to coordinate defense across contested regions.
